name: @tjohnson/abacus
description: Plug-and-play quality gates for TypeScript projects: oxlint presets (type-aware), cyclomatic/ABC complexity budgets, and gzip bundle-size budgets. Presets for plain TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, and Vite SPAs.

scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vitest run && node dist/cli.js abc && oxlint --type-aware src test
